data.name: Study Design
data.description: Study J3R-MC-YDAF (YDAF) is a Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study to investigate the efficacy and safety of subcutaneously administered once weekly eloralintide in adult participants with obesity or overweight, and T2D. The study consists of • up to a 35 day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3) • Treatment: 64 weeks o Dose escalation period: 12 weeks, and o Treatment maintenance period: 52 weeks, and • Post-treatment follow-up: 6 weeks. The visit frequency will be every 4 to 12 weeks. The maximum duration of treatment is 64 weeks. The study schema is presented in Section 1.2. Procedures and assessments for each visit are presented in the SoA in Section 1.3. A substudy of Protocol YDAF to evaluate the 24 hour glucose profile captured with CGM for eloralintide versus placebo in individuals with obesity and or overweight with T2D is described in Appendix 9 (Section 10.9). Number of Participants: Approximately 1035 participants will be randomly assigned to treatment arms of placebo, eloralintide 1.5 mg, eloralintide 3 mg, eloralintide 6 mg, and eloralintide 9 mg at a randomization ratio of 2:1:2:2:2. An upper limit of approximately 70% enrollment of AFAB participants will be used to ensure a sufficient number of AMAB participants.
data.rationale: Choice of primary endpoint In Study YDAF, the primary endpoint of percent change in body weight is a commonly used endpoint in clinical studies evaluating the efficacy and safety profile of obesity management medications in participants with obesity or overweight and T2D. Choice of comparator A placebo comparator was selected for this study in accordance with regulatory guidance (FDA 2025; EMA 2016) and to evaluate weight maintenance and dynamic changes in body composition during weight regain. Unfortunately, obesity management medication discontinuation remains common after achieving initial BW reduction, and thus the placebo arm serves as data to represent this real-world scenario (Gleason et al. 2024). In addition, all participants, regardless of treatment assignment, will continue to receive lifestyle-modification counseling consistent with current guidelines and local standards for weight management (AACE-ACE 2016; Jensen et al. 2014; Apovian et al. 2015). data.name: Venipuncture / Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for laboratory analysis including hematology, clinical chemistry, lipid panel, HbA1c, PK sampling, and other tests

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, urobilinogen, any number of these constituents; automated, with microscopy

data.label: Urine Collection
data.description: Collection of urine samples for urinalysis and urinary albumin creatinine ratio (UACR)

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: UPT
data.description: Local urine pregnancy test performed for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at specified visits

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum pregnancy test performed by central laboratory for individuals of childbearing potential at screening

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads; with interpretation and report

data.label: ECG
data.description: Central 12-lead ECG collected before blood sample collection for laboratory testing at specified visits

data.name: DXA Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites

data.label: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry
data.description: Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry scan for body composition assessment; participants unable to undergo DXA due to physical limitations or implants are not excluded

data.name: Fundus Photography

code.decode: Fundus photography with interpretation and report

data.label: Fundus Photography
data.description: Fundus photography for diabetic retinopathy screening and evaluation; performed at baseline and repeated every 6 months for participants with retinopathy or annually for those without

data.name: Ophthalmological Assessment

code.decode: Ophthalmological services: medical examination and evaluation with initiation of diagnostic and treatment program; comprehensive, new patient, one or more visits

data.label: Further Ophthalmological Assessment
data.description: Further ophthalmological assessment performed as indicated following fundus photography findings for diabetic retinopathy evaluation

data.name: Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient

data.label: Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination at Visit 1 and final visit (Visit 19 or ED); symptom-directed physical assessment at other visits per investigator discretion

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Vital signs measurement including blood pressure and pulse rate

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Collection of 3 measures of sitting vital signs including blood pressure and pulse rate, performed before ECG and before blood sample collection

data.name: Weight Measurement
data.label: Body Weight
data.description: Body weight measured in fasting state at specified visits per Section 10.7 instructions

data.name: Height Measurement
data.label: Height
data.description: Height measurement collected at screening (Visit 1)

data.name: Waist Circumference Measurement
data.label: Waist Circumference
data.description: Waist circumference measurement per instructions in Section 10.7

data.name: Self-Monitoring of Blood Glucose

code.decode: Glucose, blood by glucose monitoring device(s) cleared by the FDA specifically for home use

data.label: SMBG
data.description: 7-point self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) consisting of measurements before and 2 hours after each of 3 main meals and at bedtime, collected on two non-consecutive days within 2 weeks prior to the next visit

data.name: Continuous Blood Glucose Monitoring

code.decode: Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid via a subcutaneous sensor for a minimum of 72 hours; sensor placement, hook-up, calibration of monitor, patient training, removal of sensor, and printout of recording

data.label: CGM
data.description: Continuous blood glucose monitoring as part of CGM substudy (Appendix 9); substudy-specific schedule of activities applies

data.name: Hematology Laboratory Testing

code.decode: Blood count; complete (CBC), automated (Hgb, Hct, RBC, WBC and platelet count) and automated differential WBC count

data.label: Hematology
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for hematology panel at specified visits

data.name: Hemoglobin A1c Testing
data.label: HbA1c
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) at specified visits

data.name: Clinical Chemistry Laboratory Testing
data.label: Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for clinical chemistry panel including eGFR (CKD-EPI), liver function tests, and other chemistry markers at specified visits

data.name: Lipid Panel Testing
data.label: Lipid Panel
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for lipid panel including ApoB and ApoC3 at specified visits

data.name: Pharmacokinetic Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture for pharmacokinetic analysis

data.label: PK Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for pharmacokinetic analysis at designated PK-only visits

data.name: Anti-Drug Antibody Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture for immunogenicity testing

data.label: ADA Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for anti-drug antibody (ADA) testing at specified visits

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Study Intervention

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.description: Weekly self-administered subcutaneous injection of study intervention; first injection observed by site personnel; participants trained in self-injection technique

data.name: Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring
data.label: C-SSRS Assessment
data.description: Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) assessment using Screening/Baseline Category Version at Visit 1 and Since Last Assessed Clinical Categories Version at subsequent visits; AEs collected before C-SSRS

data.name: Depression Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment using standardized instrument

data.label: PHQ-9
data.description: Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) assessment for depression monitoring at specified visits; AEs collected before PHQ-9

data.name: Fatigue Assessment
data.label: Fatigue Assessment Scale
data.description: Fatigue Assessment Scale administered at specified visits per Section 8.2.8

data.name: Hepatic Safety Monitoring
data.label: Liver Chemistry Monitoring

data.name: High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein Testing

data.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone Testing
data.label: TSH

data.name: Follicle Stimulating Hormone Testing

data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age and of the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent.

data.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
data.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D according to the World Health Organization (WHO) classification or other locally applicable standards for at least 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1), with HbA1c ≤10.0% (86 mmol/mol) at screening (Visit 1)

data.name: Stable T2D treatment
data.text: Are on stable treatment for T2D for at least 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1), consisting of either diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins). Note: DPP-4i are allowed.

data.name: BMI requirement
data.text: Have a BMI >27 kg/m2 at Visit 1. Note: In participants with limb amputation or limb loss, the investigator should reach out to the Lilly medical monitor for information regarding calculation of BMI.

data.name: Stable body weight
data.text: Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening at Visit 1.

data.name: History of unsuccessful dietary effort
data.text: Have a history of at least 1 self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight

data.name: Contraceptive requirements
data.text: IOCBP, INOCBP, and individuals AMAB who agree to abide by the reproductive and contraceptive requirements provided in Section 10.4. may participate in this trial. See Section 10.4 for definitions and additional requirements related to contraception. Note: Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Appendix 1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
data.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as self-inject study intervention, store and take the provided study intervention as directed, maintain electronic study diary and paper log, complete the required questionnaires, and undergo DXA procedure. Note: if a person is unable to undergo the DXA due to physical limitations of the DXA machine, or because they have implants, hardware, or other foreign materials that may interfere with the scan according to the DXA manufacturer's specification, this will not be considered an exclusionary criterion.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exception: The following are allowed if performed >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction, cryolipolysis, or abdominoplasty.

data.name: Prior or planned endoscopic/device-based therapy for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device-based therapy for obesity, such as, but not limited to mucosal ablation, gastric artery embolization, laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding, intragastric balloon, or duodenal-jejunal endoluminal liner. Exception: Prior device-based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Obesity induced by endocrinologic disorders or monogenetic/syndromic forms
data.text: Have obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders, for example, Cushing Syndrome, or are diagnosed with monogenetic or syndromic forms of obesity, for example, Melanocortin 4 Receptor deficiency or Prader Willi Syndrome.

data.name: Type 1 diabetes or related conditions
data.text: Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, latent autoimmune diabetes, or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma

data.name: Severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have had 1 or more episode of severe hypoglycemia and/or 1 or more episode of hypoglycemia unawareness within the 180 days prior to Visit 1. Note: Any participant that the investigator feels will not be able to communicate an understanding of hypoglycemic symptoms and the appropriate treatment of hypoglycemia should also be excluded.

data.name: High fasting glucose
data.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Recent use of prohibited antihyperglycemic medications
data.text: Have taken within 90 days before screening (Visit 1) any of the following AHMs: amylin analogs, GLP-1 receptor agonists, GIP/GLP receptor agonists, or insulin.

data.name: Current treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
data.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of antivascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

data.name: Renal impairment
data.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr-cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Significant active autoimmune abnormality
data.text: Have evidence of significant, active autoimmune abnormality, for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis, that, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to require concurrent treatment with systemic glucocorticoids during the course of the study.

data.name: Recent cardiovascular events
data.text: Have had within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1): acute myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular accident (stroke), coronary artery revascularization, unstable angina, or hospitalization due to congestive heart failure.

data.name: NYHA Class IV congestive heart failure
data.text: Have a history or diagnosis of New York Heart Association Functional Classification Class IV congestive heart failure.

data.name: Bradycardia or AV block
data.text: Have either ongoing asymptomatic bradycardia defined as <50 beats per minute at V1, or ECG findings at V1 of 2nd degree AV block or higher, or history of symptomatic bradycardia with uncorrected etiology, including diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome. Note: Historical symptomatic bradycardia or AV nodal block due to a corrected transient etiology will not be considered exclusionary (for example, previous beta-blocker, calcium channel blocker, or other medication that can lead to AV block; or conduction disorder corrected with cardiac device).

data.name: Hepatic conditions or abnormal liver laboratory values
data.text: Have acute or chronic hepatitis, including a history of autoimmune hepatitis, signs, or symptoms of any other liver disease other than nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, or any of these laboratory values confirmed by central lab at screening (Visit 1): ALT or AST level ≥3.0x the ULN (Note: Participants with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease may participate in the study if their ALT level is <3.0x the ULN), ALP level ≥1.5x the ULN, total bilirubin level ≥1.5x the ULN, except for participants with history of Gilbert's Syndrome.

data.name: Significant uncontrolled endocrine abnormality
data.text: Have evidence of significant, uncontrolled endocrine abnormality, in the opinion of the investigator; for example, thyrotoxicosis or adrenal crisis.

data.name: Abnormal thyroid stimulating hormone levels
data.text: Have thyroid stimulating hormone levels outside the normal reference range for the central laboratory at Visit 1. Exception: Participants with hypothyroidism who are clinically euthyroid and on stable thyroid replacement therapy for at least 60 days prior to Visit 1 are acceptable exceptions to this criterion.

data.name: Family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2
data.text: Have a family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2.

data.name: History of active or untreated malignancy or recent remission
data.text: Have a history of an active or untreated malignancy or are in remission from a malignancy for less than 5 years (Visit 1). Exceptions: basal or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ carcinomas of the cervix, Grade 1 (for example, Gleason 6 or lower) prostate cancer.

data.name: Hematological condition interfering with HbA1c measurement
data.text: Have any hematological condition that may interfere with HbA1c measurement, for example, hemolytic anemias or sickle cell disease.

data.name: Significant active or unstable major depressive or psychiatric disorder
data.text: Have a history of significant active or unstable major depressive disorder or other severe psychiatric disorder, such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or other serious mood or anxiety disorder, within the last 2 years, OR In the investigator's opinion, have any significant mental health disorder that may put the individual at higher risk of study participation.

data.name: PHQ-9 score threshold
data.text: Have a PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at any screening visit (Visit 1) or at randomization (Visit 3).

data.name: Significant risk for suicide
data.text: Are, in the judgment of the investigator, deemed to be at significant risk for suicide

data.name: C-SSRS suicidal ideation or behavior
data.text: Have answered "yes" to either Question 4 or Question 5 on the "Suicidal Ideation" portion of the C-SSRS and the ideation occurred within the past 3 months OR Have answered "yes" to any of the suicide-related behaviors (actual attempt, interrupted attempt, aborted attempt, preparatory act or behavior) on the "suicidal behavior" portion of the C-SSRS, and the behavior occurred within the past 5 years. Note: Non-suicidal self-injurious behavior is not considered a suicide-related behavior.

data.name: Clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality
data.text: Have a known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality, such as severe diabetic gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction, or chronically take drugs that directly affect GI motility.

data.name: Transplanted organ or awaiting organ transplant
data.text: Have had a transplanted organ or awaiting an organ transplant. Exception: Corneal transplants or keratoplasty are allowed.

data.name: Planned surgery during the study
data.text: At the time of screening, have a planned surgery, except for minor surgical procedures, to occur during the study.

data.name: Prohibited glucose-lowering medications or insulin history
data.text: Have taken any prohibited glucose-lowering medications (see Section 6.9.3) within 90 days of Visit 1 or have a history of insulin therapy within 90 days prior to Visit 1.

data.name: Chronic systemic glucocorticoid therapy
data.text: Are receiving or have received within 90 days prior to screening chronic (>2 weeks) systemic glucocorticoid therapy (excluding topical, intraocular, intranasal, single intraarticular injections, single localized injections of skin lesions or tendon, or inhaled preparations).

data.name: Hypersensitivity to amylin or study product
data.text: Have known or suspected hypersensitivity to amylin or study product.

data.name: Recent use of weight reduction medications or remedies
data.text: Have taken within 90 days prior to screening (Visit 1) prescribed or over-the-counter medications, or alternative remedies, including herbal or nutritional supplements, intended to promote body weight reduction. Examples include, but are not limited to GLP-1RA, GIP/GLP-1RA, orlistat, sibutramine, phenylpropanolamine, mazindol, phentermine, lorcaserin, phendimetrazine, phentermine/topiramate, naltrexone/bupropion, and ingested material that transiently occupies space in the stomach, for example, hydrogel capsules made of cellulose and citric acid. Exception: AHMs for the management of T2D, for example, SGLT-2 inhibitors, are permitted, with the exception of the examples listed above used as AHM (for example, GLP-1RA, GIP/GLP-1RA).

data.name: Medications that may cause significant weight gain
data.text: Are receiving or have received within 90 days of screening, medications that may cause significant weight gain – including but not limited to tricyclic antidepressants, atypical antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers – unless at a stable dose for more than 6 months, with no planned dose changes, and documented weight stability (see Appendix 8: Section 10.8). Note: Insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1.

data.name: Recent subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives
data.text: Have started subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives such as Depo-Provera®, Nexplanon, within 18 months prior to screening (Visit 1). Note: Intrauterine devices are acceptable.

data.name: Currently enrolled in another clinical study
data.text: Are currently enrolled in any other clinical study involving an investigational product or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study.

data.name: Recent participation in a clinical study with active treatment
data.text: Within the last 90 days before screening (Visit 1), have participated in a clinical study and received active treatment or unknown if they received active treatment.

data.name: Prior participation in eloralintide study
data.text: Have previously completed or withdrawn from this study or any other study investigating eloralintide after receiving at least 1 dose of intervention.

data.name: Recent oral contrast or radionuclide procedure before DXA
data.text: Have had a procedure (within 10 days of screening [Visit 2]) where oral contrast or radionuclides were administered, for example, CT with contrast or nuclear medicine.

data.name: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or intention to conceive
data.text: Are pregnant, intending to breastfeed, or intending to conceive.

data.name: Investigator site personnel or immediate family
data.text: Are investigator site personnel directly affiliated with this study and/or their immediate family. Immediate family is defined as a spouse, legal partner, parent, child, or sibling, whether biological or legally adopted.

data.name: Any condition jeopardizing participant safety
data.text: Have any condition, unwillingness, or inability, not covered by any of the other exclusion criteria, which in the investigator's opinion might jeopardize the participant's safety, for example, hypersensitivity or contraindication.

data.name: Medical condition contraindicated for trial participation
data.text: Have any medical condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would be a contraindication to participation in the trial.

data.name: Lilly employees or employees of third parties involved in the study
data.text: Are Lilly employees or are employees of any third party involved in the study who require exclusion of their employees.

data.description: Mental health safety condition assessed at both Visit 1 and Visit 3 prior to randomization
data.text: Have a PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at any screening visit (Visit 1) or at randomization (Visit 3).

data.text: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

data.description: Central laboratory confirmation of fasting glucose at Visit 1 determines eligibility
data.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1).

data.text: Have renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr-cys formula as per Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.text: Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.text: Liver chemistry stopping criteria; hepatic safety monitoring, evaluation, and criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.description: Dose management condition based on BMI during treatment
data.text: Management of participants with BMI ≤22 kg/m2.

data.name: Perceived Excessive Weight Reduction
data.description: Dose management condition based on excessive weight loss
data.text: Management of participants with perceived excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Intestinal Symptoms / Inadequate Nutrition or Dehydration
data.description: Dose management conditions based on gastrointestinal tolerability and nutritional status
data.text: Management of participants with intestinal symptoms; management of participants with inadequate nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Unscheduled Visit Condition
data.description: Unscheduled visit triggered by investigator judgment for clinical oversight
data.text: An unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion for clinical oversight. The study site will determine if fasting status is needed prior to the visit.

data.name: No ED Procedures if Never Dosed
data.description: Condition exempting participants from early discontinuation procedures
data.text: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing the informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Screening to Treatment Transition
data.text: Participants complete an up to 35-day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3); eligibility (including PHQ-9 <15 and baseline fundus photography) must be confirmed at randomization (Visit 3) before assignment to study intervention.

data.name: Dose Escalation to Maintenance Transition
data.text: After the 12-week dose escalation period (stepping through 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg every 4 weeks), participants enter the 52-week treatment maintenance period at their randomly assigned dose (1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, or 9 mg).

data.name: Treatment to Post-treatment Follow-up Transition
data.text: After the maximum 64 weeks of treatment, all participants enter a 6-week posttreatment follow-up period and are required to complete the safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment period visit or final treatment visit.

data.name: Dose Escalation Regimen
data.text: To reach the doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW, a dose-escalation regimen stepping through each of these doses every 4 weeks will be employed.

data.name: Dose Modification for Tolerability
data.text: Dose modification may occur for management of participants with intestinal symptoms, inadequate nutrition or dehydration, BMI ≤22 kg/m2, or perceived excessive weight reduction (Sections 6.6.1-6.6.4).

data.name: Temporary Study Intervention Interruption
data.text: Study intervention may be temporarily interrupted per Section 7.1.2 and per hepatic safety monitoring criteria for study drug interruption.

data.name: Discontinuation for Liver Chemistry Stopping Criteria
data.text: Participants meeting liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1) must discontinue study intervention per hepatic safety monitoring, evaluation, and criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Participants must continue administering assigned study intervention, unless insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy. Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Initiation of New Antihyperglycemic Medications
data.text: New antihyperglycemic medications may be initiated per Section 6.9.1; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Early Discontinuation Visit Transition
data.text: ED visits will be completed by participants permanently discontinuing early from the study. If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit. These participants should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s).

data.name: Early Discontinuation from Study
data.description: Participants permanently discontinuing early from the study complete an Early Discontinuation (ED) visit; if discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, that visit is performed as an ED visit. These participants should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s).

data.name: Withdrawal Prior to First Dose
data.description: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.description: Discontinuation of study intervention per Section 7.1, including liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1).

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from the Study

data.name: Lost to Follow-up

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 35-day screening, 64 weeks of treatment (12-week dose escalation plus 52-week maintenance), and the 6-week posttreatment follow-up including the required safety follow-up visit (Visit 801).

data.name: Randomization Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (within 35 days of Visit 1), eligibility is confirmed (including PHQ-9 <15 and baseline fundus photography) and participants are randomized 2:1:2:2:2 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5, 3, 6, or 9 mg.

data.name: Dose Escalation Decision (every 4 weeks)
data.description: Every 4 weeks during the 12-week dose escalation period, the dose is stepped up toward the assigned final dose unless tolerability, nutrition/dehydration, BMI ≤22 kg/m2, or excessive weight reduction criteria require dose modification.
